questions.question:

questions.solution:

• The word **"Prudent"** means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (सावधान, विवेकपूर्ण)

• **"Wary"** refers to someone who is cautious or alert to possible dangers or problems. (सावधान)

questions.question:
Change the following from active to passive:

The officials are expected to announce the result.

options.text: The result is expected to be announced by the officials.
The result was announced by the officials.
The result has announced by officials.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "The officials are expected to announce the result."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "the result" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "are expected to announce" to "is expected to be announced" (present passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "the officials."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
**Correct Sentence:** *"The result is expected to be announced by the officials."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: **"The result was announced by the officials." – Incorrect tense (past tense).
 
• **Option 3: **"The result has announced by officials." – Incorrect grammar (missing "been" in present perfect passive).
 
• **Option 4: **"The officials announce the result." – This is active voice, not passive voice.
</ul

questions.question:
Convert the sentence from passive to active voice:

The proposal was rejected by the board.

options.text: The rejection was by the board.
The board had rejected the proposal.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Passive Voice:** The proposal was rejected by the board.
 
• **Active Voice:** To convert a sentence from passive to active voice, identify the subject performing the action and place it at the beginning of the sentence, followed by the verb and the object.
 
• **Conversion:**
 
 
• The subject performing the action (board) becomes the subject of the sentence.
 
• The verb (was rejected) changes to its active form (rejected).
 
• The object (the proposal) follows the verb.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The board rejected the proposal."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** “The rejection was by the board.”

 
 
• This option rephrases the sentence in passive voice without effectively converting it to active voice.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “The board had rejected the proposal.”
 
 
• While this option uses active voice, it changes the tense to past perfect, which does not match the tense of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** “The proposal rejected the board.”
 
 
• This option incorrectly reverses the subject and object, leading to a nonsensical sentence.

questions.question: According to the passage, how do limitations influence creativity?
questions.solution: The correct answer is: **Option (2) i.e. They stimulate innovative approaches**. questions.question:
Select the correct Direct Speech conversion:

He stated that innovation thrives under pressure.

options.text: He said innovation thrived under pressure.
He said that innovation had thrived.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He stated that innovation thrives under pressure.
 
• **Direct Speech:** He said, “Innovation thrives under pressure.”
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **“that innovation thrives under pressure” becomes “Innovation thrives under pressure”:**
 
 
• The conjunction "that" is removed when converting to direct speech.
 
• The verb "thrives" remains in the present tense as it reflects a universal truth.
 
 
 
• **Reporting Verb:**
 
 
• In indirect speech: "He stated that"
 
• Converted to direct speech: "He said," maintaining the reporting tone.
 
 
 
• **Punctuation:**
 
 
• Direct speech is enclosed in quotation marks.
 
• The quoted sentence starts with a capital letter "Innovation."
 
 
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"He said, ‘Innovation thrives under pressure.’"*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "He said innovation thrived under pressure."
 
 
• Incorrect as it changes the tense from present ("thrives") to past ("thrived"), altering the meaning.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** “He said that innovation had thrived.”
 
 
• Incorrect as it changes the tense to past perfect, implying a completed action rather than a universal truth.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "He said pressure causes innovation."
 
 
• Incorrect as it paraphrases the original statement, changing the structure and meaning.

questions.question:
Choose the correct Indirect Speech form:

She said, “I like reading novels.”

options.text: She said that she likes reading novels.
She said that she liked reading novels.
She said she was liking novels.
She said she had liked novels.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** She said that she liked reading novels.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"I like" becomes "she liked"**
 
 
• The pronoun "I" is changed to "she" to match the subject in indirect speech.
 
• Verb "like" is changed to "liked" to reflect the past tense in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Quotation removal:**
 
 
• The direct speech is converted into a reported statement without quotation marks.
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is transformed into an indirect clause introduced by "that."
 
• The sentence structure in indirect speech is modified to reflect past tense consistency.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"She said that she liked reading novels."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "She said that she likes reading novels."
 
 
• The verb "likes" is in the present tense, which is incorrect in this context as it violates the rule of tense backshifting in indirect speech.
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "She said she was liking novels."
 
 
• The use of "was liking" is grammatically incorrect as "like" is a stative verb and does not typically appear in progressive forms.
 
 
 
• **Option 4:** "She said she had liked novels."
 
 
• The use of "had liked" implies a completed action in the past, which changes the original meaning of the statement.

• "Rising temperatures disrupt habitats."

• "Many species face extinction."
